scenes.title: 연결 해설 08
lines: Different component signs represented the same final orientation. Can that orientation reveal the preceding motion? Let us follow one interval through time.

scenes.title: 연결 해설 23
lines: Our calculation turned x toward y while preserving the component parallel to the axis. We will now observe body directions separately from the camera frame that projects them on screen.

scenes.title: 숫자 세 개가 담는 방향을 날개로 관찰하기
lines: Read the direction represented by three components through the wings. This excerpt changes from bicycle travel to flight.
The red line joins the visible wing tips. Compare it with the teal screen-horizontal reference.
The camera also moves, so this projected angle is not a world rotation angle.
How do we construct four components from an axis and angle independent of the camera?

scenes.title: 속도 숫자와 자세값의 길이를 나누기
lines: The rotation quaternion had norm one. Separate the displayed speed from the visible body direction.
This is a separate flight excerpt. The red wing line shows orientation; the moving position shows a route.
A larger speed display does not imply a larger unit-rotation norm.
Next, the equipment changes to a bicycle. Apparent size and speed differ, while the unit-length condition remains the same.

scenes.title: 역회전은 주행 경로의 되감기가 아니다
lines: We inverted a unit rotation with its conjugate. Separate the red torso line from the traveled position.
Even as the bank becomes smaller, the bicycle continues forward. Rotation and translation are different changes.
An inverse cancels the defined rotation. It does not rewind elapsed time or distance.
Would conjugation alone invert a tuple whose norm is not one? We verify that condition next.

scenes.title: 변화가 없다는 연산도 입력과 결과로 읽기
lines: An endpoint pose did not store every earlier action. Observe the torso and skis during snow travel.
The red torso line and blue ski direction change together on slopes and bends.
Identity rotation does not mean that the whole game image stops. It applies no extra rotation to an input direction.
Treat the torso direction as the input. Which four components return it unchanged?

scenes.title: 같은 끝 자세와 지나온 회전 과정을 구분하기
lines: The equality of q and minus q concerned the ending orientation. Continue observing the jump and landing.
The red torso line and blue ski line record visible directions over time.
One endpoint image cannot recover the intervening turn.
Our calculation flips all components; it does not reverse rotation or rewind a route.
Which value applies no extra rotation? We verify the same input in the following explanation.

scenes.title: 평면의 회전에서 삼차원 축으로
lines: We learned about a planar angle. Observe the red torso line.
Three dimensions require an axis too. We now connect it to the three axis components.

scenes.title: 반각은 화면에서 절반만 도는 뜻이 아니다
lines: The half-angle belonged to the storage formula. Observe the red torso and blue wheel lines.
The complete two-sided operation produces ninety degrees; it does not rotate the object by half.
We now connect the four components to the visible orientation.

scenes.title: 기울기를 상쇄할 때 남는 이동
lines: Riding and flight are separate excerpts. Read speed and orientation separately.
During flight, read the red wing tilt separately from the speed display.
Which components change to undo our unit rotation? We now calculate with the conjugate.

scenes.title: 한 번의 변화에서 두 번의 연산으로
lines: An axis and angle gave us a rotation value. Observe the red torso and blue wheel lines.
What happens when we apply that rotation twice about one axis?
We now compose two ninety-degree turns into one product.

scenes.title: 고정 축과 몸체 축을 분리해 관찰하기
lines: Rotation order changed the result. Compare the red body direction with the teal screen reference.
A body direction differs from a fixed reference. The screen line is not a measured world axis.
Our calculation multiplied world-relative increments on the left and body-relative ones on the right.
How much further rotation takes the current orientation to a target?

scenes.title: 현재 자세에서 목표 자세를 묻기
lines: The multiplication side selected a reference. Separate the red torso direction from the changing position.
The game's internal target is unknown, so our next diagram defines its own current and target orientations.
Call the current orientation a and the target b. Which additional rotation takes a to b?

scenes.title: 최소 자세 차이와 동작 전체의 길이
lines: The minimum angle described the difference between two defined endpoint poses. Track the body and wheel directions.
A changing bank does not make one endpoint store every intermediate action.
Even a similar ending direction requires a time record to recover the intervening turn.
We switch to a separate excerpt; it is not the before and after of one instant.
How do we construct an intermediate direction? Next, we calculate half of a rotation.

scenes.title: 절반 회전은 네 숫자의 절반이 아니다
lines: Powers led to dividing a rotation amount. Follow the red torso line through the visible direction change.
This is a different excerpt. Read orientation separately from the traveled route.
Halving an angle does not mean multiplying all four components by0.5.
Half of ninety degrees is forty-five. We verify the distinction with logarithms and exponentials.

scenes.title: 계산한 벡터를 물체에 붙여 읽기
lines: We verified the vector rotation. Read the red torso and blue wheel lines together.
Distinguish the camera image from world-orientation calculation. We continue with another riding excerpt.

scenes.title: 반대 기울기에서 두 회전의 합성으로
lines: An inverse cancelled the rotation. Observe the red torso and blue wheel lines in this separate excerpt.
Tilt and facing change together. Can we add components to compose our two defined rotations?
We first verify dot and cross products with small numbers, then read the Hamilton product.
